turns.replyText:
How do I use it properly the very first time?

Perfect question! Here's how to get started the right way 💙

Before First Use:

Wash everything — the bottle and lid are top rack dishwasher safe, or you can hand wash with warm soapy water
Disassemble the lid before cleaning — remove the silicone plug and straw
Clean the straw properly — place it upright in the dishwasher so water flows through it, or rinse thoroughly by hand
Air dry completely before putting it back together

Using It:

The Mesa Loop has a twist-in locking straw — just twist it into place, no tilting needed
Click the button up/down to lock or unlock the lid (keeps it leak-proof!)
The airflow relief valve helps with smooth sipping through the straw
Use the loop handle to grab and go with just a finger

Quick Tips:

Don't microwave it
Keep drinks cold or hot for hours thanks to the double-walled insulation
The silicone base keeps it quiet when you set it down

That's it! Clean it first, fill it up, and enjoy. Super straightforward! 😊
